name: Ocypus Lota A40 White CPU Air Cooler Digital Display
shortDescription: Ocypus Lota A40 White CPU Air Cooler (Real-Time Digital CPU Temp & Utilization Display / 180W TDP Support / Four 6mm Direct Touch Copper Heat Pipes / High-Static Pressure 120mm PWM FDB Fan / Intel LGA1851 & AMD A
descriptionHtml:
Ocypus Lota A40 White CPU Air Cooler (Real-Time Digital CPU Temp & Utilization Display / 180W TDP Support / Four 6mm Direct Touch Copper Heat Pipes / High-Static Pressure 120mm PWM FDB Fan / Intel LGA1851 & AMD AM5 Ready / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Combine smart hardware monitoring with sleek white aesthetics using the Ocypus Lota A40 White CPU Air Cooler, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Equipped with a top-mounted digital display screen that provides real-time CPU temperature and utilization tracking alongside visual critical temperature warnings, this single-tower white air cooler supports up to 180W TDP. It features four 6mm direct-touch copper heat pipes, high-density aluminum fins, and a 120mm PWM high-static pressure fan utilizing Fluid Dynamic Bearings (FDB). Delivering up to 75.81 CFM airflow at a maximum noise level of 31.6 dB(A) with an optimized 155mm height layout, it provides excellent RAM clearance and full support for Intel LGA1851/1700 and AMD AM5 sockets.
